title: Duality Conditions for Morrey Measures via Parabolic Capacity
summary: We establish Morrey-type conditions ensuring that a finite signed Radon measure belongs to the dual of the energy space of solutions to nonlinear parabolic equations of $p$-Laplacian type. More precisely, for the parabolic cylinders $Q_{r,r^p}(z):=B_r(x)\times(t-r^p,t+r^p)$, we prove that \[ |μ|\bigl(Q_{r,r^p}(z)\cap(Ω\times (0,T))\bigr) \leq Mr^{n+p-\vartheta}, \qquad \vartheta 1$, the sufficient threshold is $\vartheta<\min\{p,q\}$.
